reasons: Lake identity is verified for United States v. Wayne Walker, decided 2015-09-03 by the U.S. Court of Appeals, 11th Circuit.

residual_risks: Disclosed treatment is only as of 2026-06-30; later changes are outside the file universe.

reasons: Support merits are outside Lens B; the currency check turns on the same verified Walker authority.

residual_risks: No Lens A support or quote-fidelity review performed.

reasons: Home-role support is outside Lens B except for currency impact.

residual_risks: The disclosed files do not define the role taxonomy for Recent development (role-based); this review treats that only as a currency/treatment issue.

residual_risks: Treatment provenance includes legacy treatment migration, which is weaker than a fully independent citator note but is not contradicted by the disclosed treatment judgment.
